https://dspy.ai/learn/optimization/optimizers/
DSPy optimizer catalog. BootstrapFewShot (teacher-generated demos, metric-validated). BootstrapFewShotWithRandomSearch (multiple attempts, 50+ examples). COPRO (coordinate ascent hill-climbing for instructions). MIPROv2 (3-stage: bootstrap traces, grounded proposals, Bayesian discrete search, 40+ trials 200+ examples). SIMBA (stochastic mini-batch, targets high-variability examples, self-reflective improvement rules). GEPA (trajectory reflection, domain feedback integration). BetterTogether (sequences prompt and weight optimization). Typical cost $2, ~10 minutes.
